data.description: The name of the languages row every project starts from: English, /de/en (the airline's English language root; no /gc tree, decision D1 of the slug order).

Multi-level: a project takes its source folder from its URLs (/de/en, /de/de), released in da-nx #793 and #870 (2026-10-29). Put the URLs of one language root in a project: English pages (/de/en) are translated into the other language roots.
Translations from /de/en into the other language roots: merge marks the differences to the existing page instead of replacing it.
No rollout is set up: every language root holds its own full copy (option B: lh-edge serves the market roots from them). Kept for the day a root is added.
Sync into /de/en: only for URLs from outside every source folder. URLs of a market root (/xx/en ...) land here and get copied to /de/en/xx/en/...: never put them in a project.
Google machine translation through Document Authoring (no keys). GlobalLink: see tools/loc/README.md.
The service environments; the first is the default.
Absolute fragment links on these hosts are added to a project with their page (relative /fragments/ links are not: add them yourself).

data.rule: translate col 2 if col 1 is "title" or "description" or "og:title" or "og:description" or "keywords" or "breadcrumb title" or "parent title" or "card-image-alt" or "author-description" or "reading-time" or "tags"
do-not-translate

data.rule: dnt col 1
dnt col 2 if col 1 is "destination" or "origin"

dnt col 2 if col 1 is "reference pattern"
dnt col 2 if col 1 is "origin" or "destinations" or "trip duration" or "cabin" or "travel months"

dnt col 2 if col 1 is "trip duration" or "max adults" or "max children" or "max infants" or "content languages"
dnt col 1 if col 1 is "caption" or "aside" or "zoom in label" or "zoom out label" or "visit website label"

dnt row 1
dnt col 2,3,4,10

dnt col 1
